title: 第一万一百一十三章 姜云接刀第一万一百一十二章 给我出来
content_zh:
曾经的古之子民，几乎全都被扔进了天地墟中。
但即便是在那样艰难的环境里，古不老依然带着古之子民成功的绝地反击。
他们不但反过来掌控了天地墟，而且还推翻了天地宗。
可想而知，在那种环境之中成长起来的古之子民实力之强。
尤其是身为古之四脉的首领，他们的实力和意志，都要远远超过一般的太初强者。
因此，器灵可以恢复千朔等人的意识，驱使他们去坐镇反五行大阵，为自己所用，但始终不敢让古寒节等人恢复意识。
甚至于，他也舍不得杀死古万疯等人。
可是现在，眼看着自己都已经被姜云给打伤，让器灵不得不做出了这个决定。
杀了古寒节四人，吸收他们的力量，从而封锁天地，让自己能够彻底立于不败之地。
“啊！”
随着古寒节四人眉心无之印的亮起，四人的身体颤抖的更加剧烈，口中更是发出了凄厉的惨叫之声。
他们的身体几乎瞬间就变得透明起来。
而看到这一幕，姜云的眼睛几乎都快要瞪出眼眶。
虽然严格说来，姜云和古寒节他们并没有真正意义上的任何接触，唯一的关系，就是他们是师父的子民，自己是师父的弟子。
但是，有了在古不老记忆中的经历，让姜云早已经将这四人当成了尊敬的长辈。
因此，看到器灵现在连他们也要杀死，姜云无论如何必须阻止，必须要救他们。
“嗡！”
虽然自身仍然在受到天劫之力的攻击，无法催动力量，但姜云的眉心之处，却是忽然亮起了一道印记。
印记形如四片花瓣！
古之印记！

但凡是古之子民，都会具备古之印记。
但姜云的古之印记，却和古之子民的印记不同。
因为，那是古不老亲自赋予他的印记，是古之一脉至高无上的传承象征。
有此印记在，古不可伤！
姜云并不知道，古之印记是否能够唤醒古寒节他们。
但此时此刻，除了古之印记之外，他也没有其他的办法了，只能试试看。
随着这道印记的亮起，一股古老而浩瀚的气息瞬间弥漫开来，仿佛跨越了时空的阻隔，直抵古寒节四人的灵魂深处。
他们的身体猛地一震，眉心那原本大方光明的无之印竟然开始剧烈闪烁，黯淡了下去。
显然，古之印记有效！
器灵冷冷的道：“就算是你师父古不老在，也救不了他们，更何况是你了！”
随着他的话音落下，器灵张开手掌，朝着四人凌空虚虚一抓。
content_en:
Almost all the ancient people were thrown into the ruins of heaven and earth.
But even in such a difficult environment, Gu Bu Lao still led the people of Gu to successfully fight back.
Not only did they control the Tiandi Ruins in turn, but they also overthrew the Tiandi Sect.
One can imagine how powerful the ancient people who grew up in that environment were.
Especially as the leaders of the Four Ancient Lineages, their strength and will far exceed those of ordinary Taichu experts.
Therefore, the weapon spirit can restore the consciousness of Qian Shuo and others, and drive them to sit in the anti-Five Elements Formation for their own use, but they never dare to let Gu Hanjie and others regain their consciousness.
Even, he was reluctant to kill Gu Wanfeng and others.
But now, seeing that he had been injured by Jiang Yun, Qi Ling had to make this decision.
Kill the four people from Gu Hanjie and absorb their power, thereby sealing off the world and making yourself completely invincible.
"Ah!"
As the seals between the four people's eyebrows lit up in Guhanjie, their bodies trembled more violently, and screams came from their mouths.
Their bodies became transparent almost instantly.
Seeing this scene, Jiang Yun's eyes almost popped out of his sockets.
Although strictly speaking, Jiang Yun and Gu Hanjie had no real contact with each other. The only relationship was that they were the master's people and he was the master's disciple.
However, with his experiences in ancient memories, Jiang Yun had already regarded these four people as respected elders.
Therefore, seeing that the weapon spirit was now trying to kill them, Jiang Yun had to stop them and save them no matter what.
"Buzz!"
Although he was still being attacked by the power of the Heavenly Tribulation and was unable to activate his power, a mark suddenly lit up between Jiang Yun's eyebrows.
The mark is shaped like four petals!
Ancient mark!
But all the ancient people will have the imprint of the ancients.
But Jiang Yun's ancient mark is different from the mark of the ancient people.
Because that was the mark given to him by Gu Bulao himself, and it was the supreme symbol of inheritance of the ancient lineage.
With this mark, it cannot be hurt in ancient times!
Jiang Yun didn't know whether the ancient mark could awaken Gu Hanjie and the others.
But at this moment, besides the ancient mark, he had no other choice but to give it a try.
As this mark lights up, an ancient and vast aura instantly fills the air, as if it has transcended the barriers of time and space and reaches the depths of the souls of the four people in Gu Hanjie.
Their bodies shook suddenly, and the originally generous and bright seal of Wu between their eyebrows began to flicker violently and dimmed.
Obviously, the ancient mark works!
The weapon spirit said coldly: "Even if your master is here, he can't save them, let alone you!"
As his words fell, the weapon spirit opened his palm and grabbed the four people in the air.
